title: A Summer for the Kitchen
author: Ada Crane
blurb: Beatrix Winterbourne, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
